mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.api_no AS apiNo, a.title, a.content, a.method, a.path, a.project_id AS projectId, a.folder_id AS folderId, p.name AS projectName, f.name AS folderName, a.status, a.proposer, a.owner, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM api_doc a LEFT JOIN project p ON a.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doc_folder f ON a.folder_id = f.id
mapper.select: WHERE a.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
WHERE a.project_id = #{projectId} AND a.folder_id = #{folderId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_doc (api_no, title, content, method, path, project_id, folder_id, status, proposer, owner, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{apiNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{method}, #{path}, #{projectId}, #{folderId}, #{status}, #{proposer}, #{owner}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_doc SET folder_id = NULL WHERE folder_id IN #{fid}
